To get the best results from your Chilly’s product:

Before first use: Wash thoroughly with hot soapy water and rinse.
Daily use:
Fill with drinks below 90°C/194°F (and follow any product‑specific rules on hot, fizzy, or organic drinks).
Keep lids/collars properly assembled, but don’t over‑tighten.
Cleaning:
Hand‑wash all parts with hot soapy water after use; don’t leave to soak.
For a deep clean, mix 1–2 tsp baking powder with a splash of water and washing‑up liquid into a paste, spread inside (focusing on marks), leave ~60 minutes, then scrub and rinse well.
What to avoid:
No dishwasher, microwave, freezer, or Milton sterilizing fluid.
Don’t leave milk, juice, or other organic drinks inside overnight (can cause pressure and damage).
Storage: When not in use, store with the cap/lid off so the inside can dry out.

Following these steps will keep performance high, prevent smells or tastes, and protect the finish and insulation.
